solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fits spelling to a text

parts.note: SP is the dictionary and proofreading abbreviation for spelling
a text message is sent by SMS, the short message service

explanation.surface: Someone fusses over spelling in a text message until they are in a fit about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Spasms are sudden involuntary convulsions, which is one sense of fits as a plural noun.

clue.text: We barely received infrared radio

indicators.note: received means taken in, so the IR goes inside the other letters

parts.note: barely means only just, with less of something, so it gives LESS

explanation.surface: We could barely pick up an infrared signal on our radio set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barely' reads as modifying 'received', but it is its own piece, a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Wireless is the old-fashioned British word for a radio set, from transmission without wires.

clue.text: Sitting next to too many cars playing music

indicators.note: next to means one piece is placed beside the other in the answer

parts.note: a traffic jam is too many cars on a road
a sitting is a session, as of a court or parliament

explanation.surface: Someone sits in gridlocked traffic listening to music.
explanation.definitionFit: A jam session is an informal gathering of musicians improvising together, so it is a spell of playing music.

clue.text: God of silence?

parts.note: silence can be read as nothing in the way of noise, a zero followed by a word for racket, and that reading names a Norse deity

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that this deity is not literally the god of silence; the name just splits into a figure for nothing and a word for loud noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Odin is the chief deity of Norse mythology, father of Thor.

clue.text: Promoting what misogynist does with Tesla

parts.note: a misogynist dislikes women, so he would prefer men
T is the symbol for the tesla, the SI unit of magnetic flux density

explanation.surface: A sexist boss at an electric car company keeps promoting men.
explanation.walkthrough: Tesla looks like the car maker but is the physics unit, symbol T.
explanation.definitionFit: Preferment is advancement to a higher office, the act of promoting someone.

clue.text: Green regulation covers nitrogen

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of, and so covers, the second

parts.note: a regulation is a law
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: Environmental rules limit the nitrogen fertiliser spread on green spaces.
explanation.definitionFit: A green is a stretch of grassy ground, such as a village green, which is a kind of lawn.

clue.text: Used to be type attracted to both sexes — it's very hot

parts.note: was is the past of be
A is a blood type
bi is short for bisexual

explanation.surface: Someone who once called themselves bisexual is described as very hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Wasabi is the fiery green Japanese condiment served with sushi, notoriously pungent.

clue.text: Using hidden detail in fingerprint, ran Ethereum network

indicators.note: the answer is a hidden detail lying inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A crypto-thief was traced by a tiny detail in a fingerprint after running off with Ethereum.
explanation.definitionFit: An intranet is a private computer network used within one organisation.

clue.text: Briefly, Duke of Edinburgh and the Queen carry on

parts.note: Prince Philip was Duke of Edinburgh; Phil is his name cut short
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the late Queen's cipher

explanation.surface: Prince Philip and the Queen briefly carry on with their royal duties.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests royal duty; to carry on here means to have affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: To philander is to have casual love affairs, which is one sense of the informal phrase carry on.

clue.text: Falls back after army destroyed once more

indicators.note: back means what remains is read from end to start
destroyed means the army's letters are wiped out of the falls

parts.note: Niagara Falls on the US-Canada border
RA is the Royal Artillery, an army branch

explanation.surface: Someone tumbles backwards again after an army is wiped out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Falls' reads as a verb, but it is Niagara Falls.
explanation.definitionFit: Again is the adverb meaning another time, a straight synonym of once more.

clue.text: Let it stand on child's hat

indicators.note: on means the first piece is placed onto the second in the answer

parts.note: stet is the proofreader's instruction meaning let it stand
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A parent tells someone to leave a hat sitting on the child's head.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stetson is a wide-brimmed cowboy hat, named after its maker.

clue.text: Rides fighter plane to partisan

parts.note: F designates fighter aircraft, as in the F-16
partisan means biased, hence unfair

explanation.surface: A fighter pilot gives a biased account of the rides they took.
explanation.definitionFit: A funfair is a travelling fair of amusement rides and stalls, so it is a collection of rides.

clue.text: Be quiet and finally choose pronoun

parts.note: sh is the command to be quiet

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of choose

parts.note: the last letter of choose

explanation.surface: A teacher hushes the class and tells them to pick a pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the third person singular feminine pronoun.

clue.text: Taking away cast-iron tub in pieces

indicators.note: a tub smashed in pieces has its letters broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Removing an old cast-iron bathtub by breaking it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Subtraction is the arithmetic operation of deducting one number from another.

clue.text: Trap mad relatives

parts.note: bananas is slang for mad
kin are relatives

explanation.surface: A family of crazy relatives is set to catch someone out.
explanation.definitionFit: A banana skin is a figurative pitfall, something that trips up the unwary.

clue.text: Caught man, a rider, with woman who is mean

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
he refers to a man
a rider is an addition to a document, as a PS is to a letter
Kate is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A man was caught riding with a woman described as mean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rider' suggests a horse or bike, but it is a postscript, an added note.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheapskate is a stingy person, someone tight with money.

clue.text: Fish soup's oddly hot on island

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third and fifth letters of soup's

parts.note: the odd letters of soup's, its first, third and fifth
H is the tap abbreviation for hot

explanation.surface: A fish soup tastes strangely spicy on some island.
explanation.definitionFit: Sushi is a Japanese dish of vinegared rice often topped with raw fish.

clue.text: Minced animal fodder eaten by soldiers outside of England

indicators.note: eaten by means the fodder goes inside the other letters

parts.note: the SAS is the British Special Air Service regiment

indicators.note: outside of takes only the outermost letters of the word England

parts.note: the first and last letters of England
hay is dried grass fed to animals

explanation.surface: Animal feed, chopped fine, is eaten by troops serving abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minced' looks like chopped, but it means walked affectedly.
explanation.definitionFit: To sashay is to walk ostentatiously with swaying hips, which is to mince in its walking sense.

clue.text: Born in endless poverty

indicators.note: endless means the word for poverty loses its final letter

parts.note: need is poverty, want

explanation.surface: Someone was born into unending poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Née, French for born, introduces a married woman's maiden name.

clue.text: The soldier cut up cube

indicators.note: in a down-reading sense, up means the whole is read backwards
cut means the soldier's letters slice into the word the

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier dices something into cubes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut up' looks like one anagram signal, but 'cut' is a container signal and 'up' a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is the cube of two, two times two times two.

clue.text: What's shown on computer chip as limits to greater processing

indicators.note: the limits of a word are its outermost letters, here of greater

parts.note: the first and last letters of greater

indicators.note: processing means the letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A computer chip is the limit on how much processing it can do.
explanation.walkthrough: The limits of 'greater' stay in place at the front; only 'chip as' is scrambled.
explanation.definitionFit: Graphics are the images and visual elements displayed on a computer screen.

clue.text: Pot might be this diversion

parts.note: read as wordplay, the answer is the word top turned round, which makes pot

explanation.surface: A pot might serve as a distraction.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: SPINNING, taken as a reversal signal, applied to TOP gives the clue word Pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning top is a toy, and a toy is an amusement or pastime, which is a diversion.

clue.text: Local crew picked up native

indicators.note: picked up means heard, as a signal is picked up

parts.note: a local is a pub, an inn, and a rowing crew is an eight

explanation.surface: The pub's rowing team recruited a local-born member.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a local is your neighbourhood pub; an eight is a rowing crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Innate qualities are inborn, present from birth, which is the adjective sense of native.

clue.text: Barnet Hospital eradicated strain

indicators.note: eradicated means that letter is wiped out of the word

parts.note: Barnet Fair is Cockney rhyming slang for hair
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A hospital in Barnet wiped out a strain of disease.
explanation.walkthrough: Barnet is a London borough, but in Cockney rhyming slang barnet means hair.
explanation.definitionFit: An air is a tune or melody, and a strain is a passage of music.

clue.text: In revolution, execute alternative King and Queen

indicators.note: in revolution means the letters are turned right round

parts.note: to execute is to kill, slay
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Revolutionaries execute the King and Queen and set up an alternative.
explanation.definitionFit: Royals are members of a royal family, and a king and queen are two such members.

clue.text: Queen Alex's tempers

parts.note: Anne was Queen of Great Britain
Al is short for Alex, so Alex's gives Al's

explanation.surface: A queen named Alex has a famous temper.
explanation.definitionFit: To temper metal or glass is to toughen it by heating and cooling, which is what annealing does.

clue.text: A witty listing

parts.note: wry means drily witty

explanation.walkthrough: 'listing' looks like making a list, but it means leaning over.
explanation.definitionFit: Awry means askew or crooked, as a ship that lists leans to one side.

clue.text: What to do with grass profit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: cut and dry grass to produce hay
second meaning: to take advantage of an opportunity

explanation.walkthrough: Grass suggests a lawn or cannabis; the literal haymaking reading is the first definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means exploiting favourable conditions for gain, which is to profit.

clue.text: Timid maiden's shocked expression

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
eek is a cry of fright

explanation.surface: A shy young woman lets out a startled cry.
explanation.definitionFit: Meek describes someone quiet, submissive and easily imposed on, a near synonym of timid.

clue.text: Compound fracture set by A&E in America

indicators.note: fracture means the word set is broken up into a new order

parts.note: the American equivalent of Accident and Emergency is the ER, emergency room

explanation.surface: A compound fracture is set by the emergency department in an American hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: A compound fracture is a medical term, but here compound is the definition and fracture the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An ester is a chemical compound formed from an acid and an alcohol.

clue.text: Some twins are rioting in citadel

definitions.note: completes a sentence: some twins are identical, an adjective

indicators.note: rioting means the letters run wild into a different order

explanation.surface: Twins are rioting inside a fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: Identical twins develop from one fertilised egg and so look exactly alike.
